statement: The readiness-planning snapshot owner's deferral is bounded: serve admission rests on the floored planning generation (or exact token equality for a current build) plus the positive-decision live veto, never on TOKEN_STATUS, so a completed build whose source token advanced mid-flight is served under exactly the class the sealed floored reuse already admits instead of being discarded for the all-false deferred contract. On GCP run 2026-08-31T00-12-47 the ratings load failed with PARTITION_SERVICE_NOT_FOUND for user table ratings partition p1 while the partition was fully present: the coordinator was p1's own raft leader with three active addressed service rows, yet every candidate was denied by the single reason planning_snapshot_refresh_pending in all 23 samples across 88 seconds, because under sustained write load the token advanced during every build and no build ever landed current. Measured on a deterministic drive of the real owner, routing and write-delivery path with the transport fingerprint rotating on every captureToken: 576 builds and 3 completions on both sides with all three stamped STALE (freshness pursuit and diagnostics unchanged), samples denied 23 of 23 before and 0 of 23 after with all three services routable, 646 stale serves all inside the sealed reuse class, zero divergences against a forced rebuild at serve time, and the safety negatives still denying (a moved live veto and genuinely not-ready evidence both yield routableServiceCount zero). No new bound, cache, authority or fallback; the 250 ms floored generation, stale grace, macrotask drain, maxItemsPerDrain, budgets, cadences and the 60-second window are untouched, and the system-table leader fail-open is unchanged. Clearing the five-node GCP ratings load is not claimed here: that requires the run.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Serve admission rests only on the floored planning generation (or exact token equality for a current build) and the positive-decision live veto; TOKEN_STATUS may be stamped and observed but is never a precondition, and no new bound, cache, authority or fallback replaces it.
A STALE build is served under exactly the class the sealed floored reuse already admits, proved by an in-witness oracle over every admission rather than by inspection.

No service is reported routable on evidence that is stale in a way that changes the answer; proved by a zero-divergence forced-rebuild audit over every stale serve plus a two-part safety negative (moved live veto, genuine not-ready).
The stale stamp, the completed token-status bookkeeping, the replacement enqueue and the reason codes are unchanged; the deferred contract still answers genuine evidence absence.

The 250 ms floored generation, the stale grace, the macrotask drain, maxItemsPerDrain 1, budgets, cadences, the 60-second window and macrotask-yield-required are untouched; the rig stays pinned at 1218 heavy builds and 824 winner reads.

No cross-owner priority edge, no scheduler change, no second ACTIVE or READY authority, and no change to the system-table leader fail-open; widening that fail-open to user tables remains an explicit owner decision recorded separately.

Every denial, rate and divergence number comes from the deterministic witness or the production-composition rig that matches the live seed within three percent; clearing the five-node GCP run is not claimed here.
